title: Repair Korean IME inside running Windows Terminal
desc: Re-arm Korean IME (TSF) inside an already-running Windows Terminal WITHOUT restarting WT. Use after crash reboot when ctfmon was not running at WT start time and WT tabs hold long-lived sessions you cannot lose. Strategy: CreateRemoteThread + LoadLibraryW msctf.dll, remote TF_InvalidAssemblyListCacheIfExist, then post WM_INPUTLANGCHANGE(REQUEST) to all CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS windows + children.
steps: Run powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/repair-korean-ime-running-wt.ps1 from repo root.
Click into a Windows Terminal tab and press the Hangul/English toggle key to test.
If still no toggle: focus a tab, then run the script again (TSF rebinds on focus event in some configs).
Use ONLY when WT tabs hold long-lived sessions; for fresh post-reboot recovery use recover-korean-console.ps1 instead.
